messages.author: Dulal Mondal
messages.body:
*Dear Users,*
*I have a trajectory file which contains 200000 frames. I am trying to
calculate distance matrix for each frame using the command *
*matrix dist .CA out distmat.dat*
*But it gives one N X N matrix.How can I generate a distance matrix
for each frame?*
*Thanking you*
*With regards*
*Dulal Mondal*

messages.author: Carlos Simmerling
messages.body:
I would wrote a script that loops over frames, using the loop variable to
select frame number in trajin (trajin mytraj.nc $a $a) and then use the
same variable in the output (distmat.$a.out). There may be other ways but
this should do what you want.
